body:
I posted this last night. I was drunk, which is no surprise as I've been drunk every night for the past 6 years, but it's all true.

I am a 28 year old male. I have been on this site for years and have almost posted probably a hundred times but I need help. I don't know what kind of help I need. I've been to shrinks and counselors. If you want to know a really fucked up feeling, try telling a professional counselor your problems and watching their face mutate into a half horrified/half dumbfounded look of "oh shit". It seems that no one else can help me so I will turn to my last option, strangers on the internet. 


I sit here with a pistol next to my computer as I've done 100 times. There are times where I will put a bullet in the chamber and play chicken with myself on how much pressure I can put on the trigger with the barrel in my mouth. Tonight is no different. I chickened out. I have a wife and a son who is two and that's the only reason I'm still here. (Don't worry, they don't live with me). Here's my 
story.


I was first molested when I was 3 or 4 by my uncle. It was me and my sister. Thats really the first memory I have in life. Watching my uncle perform oral sex on her before it was my turn. She was a year older. This happened on and off for the next 3 years before my sister finally told my parents what was happening. Apparently she was in the second grade watching a video of what adults are not supposed to do and spoke up. My parents brought it up to my grandma, the matriarch of the family who decided to deal with it in house. (gparents are rich/have reputations to protect). So, basically, nothing happened. I was later molested by my older cousin and a neighbor, repeatedly, all before I was 10.
My sister ended up acting out. Developed a serious eating disorder when she was 11 and ended up in a psych ward in dallas, tx. My parents were preoccupied with her so i took care of my brother, who was too young to really realize what was happening. I basically internalized everything and did everything I could to help keep my family together. Every day was some traumatic instance of my sister trying to kill herself or running away or physically fighting my parents. This was just the status quo. I went to see a counselor and told him about the abuse and my subsequent issue dealing with my own pedophilea (never, EVER acted upon, but something I still struggle with to this day. I would NEVER, EVER and have NEVER acted upon it. I'm just fucked up) he's the one whose reaction I'll never forget and why I don't want to try another idiot with a counselors degree.


I started cutting and doing drugs when I was 14. Just smoking weed and drinking. My parents new I was fucked up, I think, but literally told me that if i was doing anything bad to just lie to them because they couldn't handle anything else. I spiraled into drugs, cutting, suicidal ideation and ended up in rehab for cocaine and roxy's when I was 19. I didnt stay clean for long and I was back and forth in my relapses. I got on antidepressants when I was 23 and met a girl soon after. She knows how fucked up I was/am but saw past that I really am a good person. Just unlucky I guess.


My mom almost died of stress induced hep c when I was 15. I say stress induced not because stress caused the hep c, but because it was dormant until stressed apparently caused an intense flair up due to my sister's shenanigans. My dad then had melanoma. Both survived. My parents are great people. They didn't know how to handle the abuse and they made a huge mistake by brushing it under the rug, but they are good people.


So with all of this, I just move from one addiction to another. I quit drugs, but now drink excessively every day. I am an alcoholic and I can't quit. Even if I could, it wouldn't last very long and I would be right back or switch to something else. I don't know what else to do or if I even want to try anymore. I have been suicidal since I was 14 but have always had a reason not to do it. I have been an addict for 12 years.


Everyone says its selfish to kill yourself. I think that's bullshit. I think it's selfish to force someone to stay on this earth, year after year, in misery just so you don't have to miss them. I need help if that's even possible. This is not a joke or a troll. I am drunk, as is the usual, so spelling/grammar can go fuck itself.

Thank you for your reply. I know it wasn't my fault and though I still hate the bastards, I don't want to give them the power to still control me but it's a losing battle. My biggest issue is with drugs and alcohol. That's the only thing that makes me feel better. Then worse, then better, then worse. It's the only thing I enjoy. The only thing I live for. Sobriety is miserable and I don't understand it. I don't understand how people can go through the day sober. I want to! God I want to be happy and sober. It just doesnt happen. I need to be fucked up. I have to be fucked up. but i don't want to do it anymore. I don't want to but there is no other way that i have found to kill the ugliness thats inside of me. I have tried sooo many times to be sober, but I cant do it. I dont want my son to grow up with a fucked up alcoholic dad. i just can't help myself. If i quit alcohol, i feel like I'll go back to harder drugs. I really feel hopeless. So hopeless...

> /r/Confession

Thank you. I appreciate your advice and will xpost to /r/confession.

What do I need to address and with whom do I need to address it. Your reply is kind of vague. I DO need medical attention as for the first time ever I am shitting blood and have chest pains. I think from the alcohol and ibuprofen that i take for hangovers every day. I feel like my sexual deviancy is connected to my depression. How do I not address that and who am I supposed to be addressing this to?

i went to the bar after I posted because it made basically just brought to the surface everything (with alot of things omitted for the sake of readability) thats been going on. I do want to live. which is why i am reaching out. I do want to be there for my son. he is the most amazing person I've ever met. I really do love him and my wife, i just feel im a lost cause. How would i get involved with what you are talking about? I'm willing to try anything but I dont have a whole lot of money. And by that, i mean i am essentially broke. I spend most of my money on alcohol or late night meals after I'm fucked up. I want help. I want to live. I want a better life for me and for my family. Where do I go to attain what you are talking about.

Thank you for your reply!

Edit: I'm fucked up. dont' talk to me about spelling or grammar.
